title: Pollen Aerobiome Raw sequence reads; Metabarcoding
description: Airborne pollen concentrations over two pollen seasons at locations in the sub-tropical climate of southeast Queensland (Mutdapilly and Rocklea) and the temperate climate of New South Wales (Macquarie Park and Richmond), Australia, were determined using a continuous flow volumetric impaction air sampler.
